teacher_initial.raw_label_audit: Existing all-query audit receipt re-bound to the identical teacher SHA; full pickle/raw replay requires --checkpoints.

teacher_extra.raw_label_audit: Existing all-query audit receipt re-bound to the identical teacher SHA; full pickle/raw replay requires --checkpoints.

excluded_debug_v1.reason: Add shared memory for deterministic acceptance-bound rejections; same preregistered seeds will be recollected
excluded_debug_v1.scope: All files retained. Completed-case work is an exact subtotal; interrupted/unflushed tail is not presented as zero work. No teacher.pkl was produced and this collection will not train models.

teacher.scope: Teacher depth-2 observed evidence is actor-only, not PPO rollout or horizon-16 critic target; interrupted v1 costs separate, unflushed tail unknown.

teacher_root_diagnostics.scope: Post hoc offline diagnosis of all 96 registered teacher roots; highest return among queried depth-2 suffixes only. No new queries, no PPO or horizon-16 oracle claims.

initial.scope: Masked supervised actor loss over queried evidence only; no unknown negative labels

continued.scope: Masked supervised actor loss over queried evidence only; no unknown negative labels

pipeline_receipt.scope: Numerical/interaction correctness only; not superiority evidence

prior_debug_pipeline_receipt.scope: Numerical/interaction correctness only; not superiority evidence

bc.scope: BC supervised updates and pipeline interactions are not included in formal PPO actions.

rule_selection.scope: All four registered ILS development-grid means independently recomputed; separate from 24 validation cases.

ppo_iterations.scope: Actual fresh interactions; collector boundaries do not terminate or finalize episodes.

completed_episodes.scope: All complete-episode scalar ledgers recomputed for this uninterrupted formal run, not path replanning. complete_s includes optimizer/other-worker/validation waiting and is NOT deployment latency. Active worker episodes are separate. Resume would require separate pre/post-load certificate-cache accounting.

saved_evaluations.scope: All saved final/stage JSON rows and evidence ledgers recomputed; this is not new path execution or timing. Only six explicitly identified cases are replayed with --replay.

reviewer_scope: Independent ledger recomputation by teacher-module author; not zero-context external review.
